name: Linali Andrea
manifesto: I strongly believe that fashion is the best form of self expression.
bio: I’m a fashion designer from Panadura, Sri Lanka, studying Fashion and Textile Design with Northumbria University. I work by hand, in Dumbara weaving, crochet, macramé, embroidery and reconstructed denim, and I give every collection an emotional subject: healing, motherhood, slowing down, renewal.

facts.label: Recognition
facts.title: Represented Sri Lanka at four World Chess Championships
